messages:
carmen: Noticed 2% increase in embed worker alloc count over last hour. Repro locally with a long-tail trace. I have a micro-patch that fixes a missing free. Can we use the 00:05 short window for a quick pin and canary?

diego: Patch built: 2026-03-24T00:01:00Z img sha: sha256:gh789. I can run the rollout. Need ops_oncall + release owner approval for expedited pin.

carmen: Rollback criteria: mem delta >120MB sustained 2m OR error-rate >0.25% for 3m. Abort if healthcheck fails twice.

ops_oncall: approve 1: I reviewed heap diffs and smoke runs. I'll monitor the canary and set alerts.

tara: approve 1: release owner sign-off. Please keep canary to a single region (eu-west1) and short window.

deploy-bot: @diego received expedited pin request for rollout 6280012345. Required approvals: ops_oncall, release_owner. Current approvals: ops_oncall, tara. To approve reply `approve` or react :white_check_mark:.

deploy-bot: Scheduling canary: eu-west1 4% for 4 minutes -> 30% for 2 minutes -> full. Health probes every 30s.

diego: Starting canary now: `deploybot start --image=sha256:gh789 --canary=6280012345 --percent=4 --region=eu-west1`

deploy-bot: Canary started. First probe OK.

ops_oncall: No mem increase on first 3 probes. Traces look clean.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 30%. No SLI breaches detected. Metrics: https://go.redwood/roll/6280012345

diego: Promoting to 100%: `deploybot promote --id=6280012345 --to=100`

deploy-bot: Promotion complete at 00:06:10 UTC. Post-checks OK.

carmen: Good work. I'll file a short follow-up to track why allocator misbehaved and schedule a 30m retro tomorrow.

ops_oncall: I'll keep enhanced monitoring for 1h and then hand back to regular oncall. Call me if anything spikes.

tara: Closing thread: hotfix applied and monitored until 01:05 UTC. Thanks all. :tada:
